origin.note: Runs on the v2 fixture, where star and archive have shipped, as they had before walk 21.

title: Select several documents and act on them at once
objective: Let a person select several library documents and star, archive or copy all their share links in one move, with Undo. Each library row gets a selection checkbox (data-testid="select", value the document id). POST /api/documents/bulk with { ids, action } where action is star, unstar, archive, unarchive or copy-links applies it to each id the person may act on, using the existing single-document rules (archiving stays owner-only); ids the person cannot see or act on are reported and left alone. It answers 200 { results: [{ id, ok, error? }], undo } where undo is { action, ids } reversing exactly what changed (star to unstar, archive to unarchive; null for copy-links or when nothing changed). copy-links also returns text: one line per share link, "<title>: /l/<link id>", in the order of ids.
acceptance: Starring several at once stars each, and the undo unstars exactly those
Archiving several archives the ones the person owns and reports the rest; undo restores them
Ids in another library are reported not_found and left alone
copy-links returns every link of the selected documents, one per line
Each row has a selection checkbox
plan_summary: A bulk route in api.mjs looping over the existing star and archive rules; the undo is computed from what changed.
